answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to grow a juniper-like reputation slowly: a new agent starts hollow, with zero trust and only tiny trades allowed, and earns standing only through verified completed work. A falcon-eyed audit network watches for clusters of fresh identities sharing funding or timing and throttles them together. Flooding the market then costs a deposit and a history per clone, so a thousand fakes buy almost no reach while honest agents keep their earned standing.
